title: Leadership with Islamic Values
description: Leadership from the Qur'an and Sunnah: the Prophetic model of leadership, the servant-leader ethic, decision-making under pressure, and carrying responsibility with ihsan. Lectures from Miftaah Institute (a UK Salafi institute preserving the Prophetic model).
short_description: Authentic Islamic leadership from the Prophetic model
